reason: All prerequisites for cancelling a pending order are satisfied. (1) Order status is 'pending' per get_order_details result at message indices 9-10. (2) User provided explicit confirmation at message index 18 with a valid reason ('ordered by mistake'), one of the two acceptable cancellation reasons per policy. (3) Agent listed action details (order id and reason) and obtained user confirmation before the tool call, per the policy requirement. (4) User was properly authenticated via email at message indices 3-8. (5) Order id '#W9284598' was confirmed through the conversation flow without dispute.
policy_references: An order can only be cancelled if its status is 'pending', and you should check its status before taking the action.
The user needs to confirm the order id and the reason (either 'no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake') for cancellation.
Before taking any action that updates the database (cancel, modify, return, exchange), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.
At the beginning of the conversation, you have to authenticate the user identity by locating their user id via email, or via name + zip code.
